decision: Rejected: gains are mixed and sampling dispersion is large; no production change.
candidate: Replace the eight-symbol u64 SWAR pack with six direct byte shift/OR expressions. Same512-byte inverse tables and eight-symbol validation before any output store; same four-symbol tail and error routine.

correctness.comparison: Exact error kind/index and complete output/canaries matched baseline.

measurement.buffers: same input and output memory for each compared pair

result: Examples of median old/new latency ratios: Standard8=0.975,12=0.979,24=0.992; URL8=0.758;32chars=1.04–1.07;4096chars Standard=0.978 and URL=1.162. All samples are retained; these noisy kernel diagnostics are not full API performance claims.
assembly_observation: In this focused generic build, direct-byte packing replaces two output stores (4+2bytes) with six byte stores. Both wrappers retain eight input bounds checks per loop and a104-byte stack frame. Arithmetic reduction did not establish a consistent speed improvement.
